item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 26/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft now covering southern China will weaken gradually in the next couple of days. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. A dry northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong early to midweek next week. The weather will improve gradually over the region. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
